profile.headline: Software Engineer II at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary: I’m a Full-Stack Web Developer that prefers the frontend aspects of development. I also have experience in UX/UI design and user research studies. My long-time passion has been to create fun and attractive websites using the appropriate project lifecycle and the latest technologies. I use my interest for design and my knowledge of code to bring the most intricate projects to life.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Conduct user research, persona creation, and usability testing to determine areas of improvement regarding the user experience and preference of design by majority.
• Collaborate with team and shareholders to determine brand identity and goals of the organization as well as how to implement them visually.
• Using Photoshop, Illustrator, or InDesign, create vector art images and logos per project requirements.
• Using Sketch or Figma create design workflows, prototypes, and UI component libraries
• Develop pixel perfect websites based on design files using required technology stack.
